<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-INS-003</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Installation and upgrade</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Server log (Docker)</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>✗ Nothing to upgrade: this database is EMPTY — SENTIENT is not installed.</span></div>

## Why it happens

The installer was not run, or it stopped before it created the database schema. With ClickHouse, the installer sets up ClickHouse first, so a ClickHouse problem stops it early.

## Fix it

Run the installer once, then start again:

```bash
docker compose -f <compose file> run --rm -e INSTALL_SENTIENT=true sentient
docker compose -f <compose file> up -d
```

If you did run it, scroll up in that run's output for the first error.

## Check that it worked

`docker compose -f <compose file> logs sentient` shows the server listening on port 8080.
